'''Orlian''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. When stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] during the [[Quesh war]], he was the key scientist at the Empire's Quesh venom processing lab, though he eventually decided to defect to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. His overseer [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jesh]] caught on to his suspicious behavior and incarcerated Orlian, though he was nevertheless sprung out and extracted by a Republic citizen shortly after that, and [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Meldo]] moved Orlian to one of the SIS's safe houses
